tg_innkeeper: Rooms are three silver and you will not get one. We have been full since the spring.
Not sailors either. Surveyors, hands, men with cases they carry themselves.
They pay on time and they do not talk. I have never liked a quiet guest.
tg_inn_drover: Twenty-two loads I have brought down the ridge road this month.
Same shipper, same seals, same instruction: do not open, do not ask.
The money is very good. That is usually the bit that costs you later.
tg_inn_ridgehand: They pay us to carry it off the dray and not to carry it into the yard.
It goes straight onto the water at the east mole. Straight out.
Whatever it is, it is not for Tideglass. We are just the doorstep.
